findings.text: follow-on: the negative_control_note states the mutation leaves '3 failed at EXIT=1', while negative_control.log, the log that same field names, now records '4 failed, 6 passed' at EXIT=1 because the CLI tests c80675ecb added redden under it too; the note is a stale count of the receipt it points at, so a reader reconciling the two finds a disagreement the log's own FAILED lines resolve against the note.

VERDICT goal: the node's goal is one brief composed from the roadmap payload, and the commits this review covers (c80675ecb, 1f8fbee4d, a68290446, ea0f9eca5) repair the reach constant, the inert --since and the unhandled budget refusal the prior review named, delivered through reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1566 and reckon/project_brief.py:85.
VERDICT done_when: the dispatch done-when requires a parsed record scoring six dimensions with the revision pair and the added-failure fields; the source manifest's check for the source node names tests/test_one_brief_an_agent_can_act_on.py plus three suites, and its tests: line, gate.log (`75 passed in 133.79s` at EXIT=0 on revision 1f8fbee4d) and negative_control.log are the receipts this record reads.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/project_brief.py, reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py, tests/test_one_brief_an_agent_can_act_on.py and the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/a-project-reads-as-one-picture/, and `git diff --stat e7ab60a39f2111ffd578e9243aaa4bb9d3d6d7a3 ea0f9eca5a2e44ed90f6d88bf63ff9bca2619911` names exactly those four files, +175/-6, and no other.
VERDICT manifest: read at the reviewed head; status complete, commits end at ea0f9eca5a2e44ed90f6d88bf63ff9bca2619911, tests: is the literal shell command with absolute paths, test_logs names gate.log and brief-power_convertor.log, and classification.json carries manifest.data.baseline_suite null and manifest.data.after_suite null because this is an implement-role node, so no added-failure row can be derived and the count is zero.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against e7ab60a39f; c80675ecb adds TOP_REACH_SECTIONS (reckon/project_brief.py:43), the --since guard (reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1569), the ValueError-to-ClickException conversion (:1510) and four CLI tests, 1f8fbee4d rebuilds the reach fixture and writes EXPECTED_REACH out at tests/test_one_brief_an_agent_can_act_on.py:53, and a68290446 and ea0f9eca5 revise the evidence fragment alone.
CALL_SITES: reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1566 (the roadmap verb on the Click group) -> :1588 (_print_roadmap_brief) -> :1504 (project_brief), pyproject.toml:50 (console script `reckon = reckon.cli:main`) -> reckon/cli.py:122
SCORE goal_fidelity: 17
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: the increment closes both CLI holes the prior review opened -- the window refusal at reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1569 and the converted budget refusal at :1510 -- but the plan clause that the MCP serves the brief as roadmap's default answer (docs/plans/a-project-reads-as-one-picture.html:111) is still unlanded and no reckon/mcp.py path is in the fence.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate.log names revision 1f8fbee4d, the tree, the measurement module and the literal command, and its own `75 passed in 133.79s` at EXIT=0 is a replayable receipt, with the two commits above it touching the fragment only (git show --stat a68290446, ea0f9eca5), but baseline_suite and after_suite are null in the run record and manifest.md:20 contradicts the failure count in the log it names.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: `git diff --stat e7ab60a39f2111ffd578e9243aaa4bb9d3d6d7a3 ea0f9eca5a2e44ed90f6d88bf63ff9bca2619911` touches exactly the four declared paths, with no plan meta line, no reckon/mcp.py and no figure added.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: each of the four CLI tests is shown to redden by a recorded mutation -- negative_control_cli_guard.log fails test_the_brief_refuses_over_budget_with_a_message_not_a_traceback and test_a_change_window_without_a_brief_is_refused_before_the_scan (2 failed, EXIT=1), negative_control_cli_output.log fails three print-path tests, and negative_control_reach.log and negative_control_reach_order.log each fail test_every_figure_in_the_brief_equals_its_roadmap_field -- and the added reach assertion at tests/test_one_brief_an_agent_can_act_on.py:406-410 is compared against the fixture's written-out EXPECTED_REACH at tests/test_one_brief_an_agent_can_act_on.py:53 rather than against a value the test handed in.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: the new constant follows the docstring-comment form of its neighbours (reckon/project_brief.py:43 beside :38) and the refusal conversion repeats the verb's own idiom (reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1510 in the shape of :1477), with no name the naming rules forbid.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: searched reckon/roadmap.py, reckon/roadmap_ranking.py, reckon/mcp.py, reckon/crew and tests/ for a composition of the roadmap payload into a brief and for a shared Click invocation helper, and found project_brief's only production caller is reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1504 while CliRunner is invoked ad hoc per test file with no shared helper, so the increment adds a constant and four tests rather than forking an owned capability.
FINDING /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261022T095832133667-one-brief-an-agent-can-act-on/manifest.md:20 follow-on: the negative_control_note reports '3 failed' where the log it names records '4 failed, 6 passed' at EXIT=1, so the manifest's commentary disagrees with its own receipt.
